segments.text: > Part of the [Implementation Status](README.md) index. `crypto.subtle.*` delegates to a native crypto library selected with `-crypto`: OpenSSL 3 libcrypto (default, all platforms) or Apple CommonCrypto + Security.framework (`-crypto=commoncrypto`, macOS only) — a per-backend C file implementing one shared `__kml_crypto_*` ABI, compiled+linked only when a program uses `crypto.subtle` ([TDD-00104](../tdd/TDD-00104.md)). `crypto.getRandomValues`/`randomUUID` need only a real CSPRNG (`arc4random_buf`/`getrandom()`), no external library.
Shared `crypto.subtle` caveats (apply to every ✅ subtle row):

- The algorithm argument must be a string literal or an object literal with a literal `name:` (a variable holding the name is a compile error — compile-time dispatch)
- Results return as settled task promises: `await`/`.then`/`.catch`/`.finally` all work, but operational failures throw synchronously at the call site instead of rejecting the promise
- Bare `crypto.subtle` as a value (e.g. `const s = crypto.subtle`) is not supported — methods must be called directly

caveats: A whole `ArrayBuffer` is accepted as a deliberate extension (real JS throws `TypeMismatchError` — only integer TypedArrays are spec-legal) ([ADR-00554](../adr/ADR-00554.md))
notes: The spec's 65,536-byte quota is enforced — an oversize view throws `QuotaExceededError`; a float TypedArray (`Float32Array`/`Float64Array`) is a compile-time rejection, matching the spec's `TypeMismatchError` ([ADR-00554](../adr/ADR-00554.md))
Fills any integer TypedArray/`ArrayBuffer` in place and returns it ([ADR-00317](../adr/ADR-00317.md)); the legacy plain-`number[]` form (one random byte value per element) still works
See [ADR-00024](../adr/ADR-00024.md)
RFC 4122 version-4 UUID string
See [ADR-00024](../adr/ADR-00024.md)

caveats: Shared subtle caveats above only
notes: SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 over a TypedArray/`ArrayBuffer`, → `Promise<ArrayBuffer>`
See [ADR-00316](../adr/ADR-00316.md)

caveats: On `-crypto=commoncrypto` only: a non-empty RSA-OAEP `label` throws `NotSupportedError` (SecKey has no label parameter)
Shared subtle caveats above
notes: AES-GCM (`iv`, optional `additionalData`, optional `tagLength` default 128; auth failure → `OperationError`), AES-CBC (`iv`, PKCS#7), and RSA-OAEP (public encrypts / private decrypts, optional `label`), → `Promise<ArrayBuffer>`

caveats: On `-crypto=commoncrypto` only: RSA-PSS `saltLength` must equal the hash length or `NotSupportedError` is thrown (SecKey fixes salt = digest size)
Shared subtle caveats above
notes: HMAC (constant-time verify), RSA-PSS (runtime `saltLength`), ECDSA P-256/P-384/P-521 (per-call literal `hash`, raw `r‖s` signatures), → `Promise<ArrayBuffer>`/`Promise<boolean>`

caveats: `publicExponent` restricted to 65537 (the literal `new Uint8Array([1, 0, 1])`, or omit it)
Shared subtle caveats above
notes: AES-GCM/AES-CBC (`length:`), HMAC (`hash:`, spec-default length), RSA-OAEP/RSA-PSS (`modulusLength`, `hash`) and ECDSA (`namedCurve`) → `Promise<CryptoKey>` / `Promise<CryptoKeyPair>` (`.publicKey`/`.privateKey`); usages enforced and spec-split across the pair

caveats: `jwk` is surfaced as a `Map<string,string>` (this compiler has no dynamic object model), key-material members only (`kty`/`k`/`crv`/`n`/`e`/`d`/…) — no `key_ops`/`ext`/`alg` members; import never validates `kty`
`CryptoKey.algorithm`/`.usages` property reads not implemented (`.type`/`.extractable` work)
`raw` export of a non-EC asymmetric key isn't rejected (yields the stored DER)
Shared subtle caveats above
notes: `raw` (AES/HMAC bytes; EC public uncompressed points both ways), `pkcs8` (private), `spki` (public), `jwk` (oct/RSA/EC; object literal or Map in, Map out); kind/format mismatches and non-extractable export throw `InvalidAccessError`

Node's lib/internal/crypto/hash.js in TypeScript over the backend's incremental digest contexts: every digest the backend has (`shake128`/`shake256` with `outputLength`), Node's argument validation and error codes (`ERR_CRYPTO_HASH_FINALIZED`, `ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE`, `Digest method not supported`)
See [ADR-01300](../adr/ADR-01300.md)
caveats: On `-crypto=commoncrypto`: `md5`/`sha1`/`sha224`/`sha256`/`sha384`/`sha512` only — SHAKE, SHA-3, SHA-512/t, RIPEMD-160 and BLAKE2 throw `Digest method not supported`

notes: Every cipher the backend has, with `setAutoPadding`, and `setAAD`/`getAuthTag`/`setAuthTag` for AEAD modes; key/IV length errors and `bad decrypt`/`Unsupported state or unable to authenticate data` as Node reports them
See [ADR-01300](../adr/ADR-01300.md)
caveats: On `-crypto=commoncrypto`: AES-128/192/256 in CBC, ECB, CTR and GCM only — other ciphers throw `ERR_CRYPTO_UNKNOWN_CIPHER`

notes: The callback forms run on the thread pool, as Node's do
See [ADR-01300](../adr/ADR-01300.md)
caveats: On `-crypto=commoncrypto`: the digests are the six `createHash` has there

notes: `randomBytes`/`randomFill` callbacks run on the thread pool; `randomInt` is Node's rejection-sampling loop
See [ADR-01300](../adr/ADR-01300.md)

caveats: Keys are PEM strings only: `generateKeyPair` needs `publicKeyEncoding: { type: 'spki', format: 'pem' }` and `privateKeyEncoding: { type: 'pkcs8', format: 'pem' }` (no `KeyObject` results, `pkcs1`/`sec1`/`der`, or `cipher`/`passphrase`); key types `rsa`, `ec`, `ed25519`, `x25519`
An encrypted PEM key (`{ key, passphrase }`) is not decrypted
On `-crypto=commoncrypto`: RSA keys of 1024 bits or more with exponent 65537, and EC keys on P-256/P-384/P-521 only
notes: Generation runs on the thread pool in the callback form
See [ADR-01300](../adr/ADR-01300.md)
The global `crypto.subtle` works; the module does not re-export it

caveats: The spec's extractable=false requirement on PBKDF2/HKDF base keys is not enforced
Shared subtle caveats above
notes: PBKDF2 (`salt`, `iterations`, literal `hash`) and HKDF (`salt`, optional `info`, literal `hash`); deriveBits → `Promise<ArrayBuffer>`, deriveKey → AES-GCM/AES-CBC/HMAC `Promise<CryptoKey>`
See [ADR-00320](../adr/ADR-00320.md)
